claims.text: In Ghostbusters (1984), the team's headquarters is a converted fire station.
The Ghostbusters do not base themselves in a library, a hotel or a police station; the library and a hotel are places where they meet ghosts.
Exterior shots of the headquarters show the firehouse of Hook and Ladder Company 8 in Tribeca, New York.
The first ghost in Ghostbusters appears in the New York Public Library.
